voice.text: Black Beauty eats grass all day. [pause] But what does the <emphasis>grass</emphasis> eat? Tap your guess.
Every leaf is a <emphasis>food factory</emphasis>. [pause] In go sunlight, carbon dioxide from the air, and water. [pause] Out come sugar — the plant's food — and oxygen.
The food does <emphasis>not</emphasis> come from the soil. [pause] Roots hold the plant, and drink water. The food is made up in the leaf.
Oxygen is the factory's leftover. [pause] The leaf simply lets it go — and animals, like you, get to breathe it.

Black Beauty is built for the grass. [pause] Long legs and hard hooves, to outrun danger. [pause] Flat teeth, to grind grass — a fox's pointed teeth slice meat. [pause] Mane and tail? A built-in fly swatter.
Structures make the next generation too. [pause] The flower makes seeds. The fruit carries and protects the seed. And an egg shell protects the chick inside.
Drag each card to <emphasis>into the factory</emphasis>, or <emphasis>out of the factory</emphasis>. [pause] If it is not part of the recipe at all, tap Not in the recipe.
Factory running! [pause] Now — every structure has a job.
Look at each body part or plant part. [pause] Tap the job it does. Nothing on a wild animal is just decoration.
Every structure earned its keep! [pause] Now show what you know.
